# bumbleflies

> Facilitation, AI Consulting, and App Development for organizations navigating change. Based in Munich, serving the DACH region. Three founders, four service pillars, one goal: helping teams talk, decide, and build.

We help teams move from conversation to code. Our approach combines structured facilitation with hands-on technical execution — no consulting decks that collect dust, just work that sticks.

## Services

- [Talk — Facilitation & Workshop Design](https://bumbleflies.de/services): Structured dialogue that surfaces real issues and creates clarity. bumble:space (Open Space), team alignment, sensitive topics.
- [Decide — Decision-Making & Strategy](https://bumbleflies.de/services): From strategic direction to operational ownership. Decisions that stick because the right people made them.
- [Build & Embed — Software Development](https://bumbleflies.de/services): Custom software, internal tools, and AI applications built to solve real organizational problems. Not handoffs — partnerships.
- [Full Journey — End-to-End Engagement](https://bumbleflies.de/services): From first conversation through implementation. When the problem doesn't fit a single box.

- [AI Consulting](https://bumbleflies.de/ai-consulting): Practical AI for organizations — no hype, just results. From strategy to implementation.

## How We Work

- [Our Approach](https://bumbleflies.de/how-we-work): How facilitation and development connect. The bumbleflies method.
- [Why bumbleflies](https://bumbleflies.de/why-bumbleflies): Why teams choose us and keep coming back.
- [Why We Exist](https://bumbleflies.de/why-we): The integrated model — why one team doing Talk + Decide + Build beats fragmented vendors.
- [Risk Derisking](https://bumbleflies.de/risk-derisking): How we reduce risk in organizational change.
- [Open Space](https://bumbleflies.de/open-space): Our Open Space facilitation principles.

## Case Studies

- [Siemens AG — Enterprise Team Alignment](https://bumbleflies.de/case-studies/siemens): Full-day workshop with a large enterprise team. Clear decisions, named owners, immediate follow-up bookings.
- [LeagueSphere — Building a Regional SaaS](https://bumbleflies.de/case-studies/leaguesphere): From spreadsheet chaos to live product across 6+ German leagues. 5-year partnership, recurring SaaS revenue.
- [Dialograum Geld — Values-Driven Community Dialogue](https://bumbleflies.de/case-studies/dialograum-geld): Open Space facilitation for sensitive money conversations. Taboo lifted, community voices heard.
- [Wohnungshelden — Annual Team Alignment](https://bumbleflies.de/case-studies/wohnungshelden): Annual Open Space retrospective that teams actually look forward to. Ritual, not obligation.
- [UnternehmerTUM — Agile Transformation at Scale](https://bumbleflies.de/case-studies/unternehmertum): Multi-cohort training and coaching. Blended Talk+Decide model for sustained organizational change.
